Details 
 Step into refined luxury with Cuadra’s brown dress boots for men, crafted from an exclusive combination of genuine python and premium bovine leather. Designed for men who value authenticity and bold elegance, these mens dress boots offer a timeless silhouette elevated by exotic textures.
 The upper showcases intricate perforated leather along the top margin and side panels, adding a subtle artisanal touch to the bold python pattern. Hand-painted for a unique finish, each pair delivers a one-of-a-kind aesthetic.
 An internal zipper ensures a sleek fit and effortless on-off wear, while the leather sole with TPU injection offers enhanced grip and flexibility—perfect for polished style in any setting.
 Additional details like the engraved Franco Cuadra logo on the shaft subtly reinforce its luxury appeal, making this a standout piece whether worn to a formal occasion or upscale night out.
 Cuadra boots follow US sizing. Refer to the size chart to find your perfect fit. Note: Python leather is a natural material; color variations and marks are part of its authenticity.
 Materials
 Python: Python leather is smooth with distinctive scales, offering contrasting designs that have made it a favorite in the fashion industry. Its exotic allure continues to inspire and fascinate designers.
 Care
 Python leather needs specific care.
- Remove dust and dirt using a soft brush or damp cloth.
- Hydrate the leather with a specialized cream to prevent drying out.
- Clean the soles with a brush and mild soap solution.
- Lightly polish the footwear with a soft cloth after applying the cream.
- Use shoe trees to maintain shape.
 *NOTE: This leather cannot be sent to the state of California.
